Facing a mountain? Here is a winner's answer.

Kevin explains perseverance as never stopping and never yielding. You make a decision, and you get back up every time you are knocked down.

When faced with a mountain, he says you climb over it, drill through it, go around it, or stay and turn that obstacle into a gold mine.

He calls that the attitude of a winner, a champion and somebody who is wealthy.

Which of those four moves do you reach for first?

hook: Why Focusing On How Blocks Success
clips.caption:
Stop asking how. Start asking what you want.

Kevin explains that focusing on the how means focusing on the facts, and facts are only what is on your radar screen right now.

He says most of what is possible is off that screen because it has not come in yet. The opportunities and solutions will not present themselves until your attitude is right first.

When the attitude is right, he says, all the facts change.

What do you want clearly enough to stop asking how?
